description: Native Solanum Umbra item creation, resource tiers, crafting result ladder, and support modifiers from pages 151-167.

entries.title: Item Creation System
entries.summary: Crafting combines technology level, resource availability, item complexity, mentors, tools, skill, workshops, and materials into a modified d20 roll compared against a five-result success ladder.
body: The source calls several positive values ‘difficulty modifiers’ but then adds them to the d20 result, making advanced technology and complexity increase the final result. The wiki preserves that printed procedure and flags the terminology as a native-system ambiguity rather than reversing the signs.

The printed sequence is: choose technology level, choose resource availability, choose item complexity and time, apply support modifiers, roll d20, add the total modifier, and compare the final result to the outcome table.
A result above 20 is treated as Exceptional Success in the worked example.

tables.title: Resource Availability and Complexity
rows: Difficult to find and requires extensive search
Nearly impossible to find; often quest material

tables.title: Crafting Complexity and Time
rows: Moderate complexity and several moving parts

tables.title: Crafting Failure and Success
rows: Failure: item unusable or resources may be lost
Partial Success: functional with minor issues
Superior Success: exceeds expectations with bonuses or features
Exceptional Success: extraordinary item with unique attributes or powers

procedure: Select Technology Level and record its printed modifier.
Select Resource Availability and record its modifier.
Select Item Complexity, time, and modifier.
Apply mentor, item, skill, workshop, and material modifiers.
Roll 1d20 and add the total modifier exactly as printed in the source.
Compare the final result to the crafting outcome table.

entries.title: Crafting Support Modifiers
entries.summary: Mentors, tools, skill level, workshop quality, and material quality modify the native crafting roll.
body: Mentors must be physically present and commit significant time. Tools and components affect precision and function. Skill reflects the crafter’s training. Workshop and material quality can reduce or increase the final modifier.

The source describes negative values as reductions in difficulty and positive values as increases, even though the core example adds positive technology and complexity values to the success roll. This contradiction remains visible.

tables.title: Crafting Skill Modifiers
rows: Major increase in difficulty and time

tables.title: Workshop Quality Modifiers
rows: Major impact on success and quality

tables.title: Material Quality Modifiers
rows: Very high difficulty and failure risk

workedExample.support: Skilled Mentor -2, Advanced Tools -3, Proficient Skill -2, Well-Equipped Workshop -2, Premium Materials -4

entries.title: Communications and Resource Item Tiers
entries.summary: Communication equipment and sorted resources use Scavenged through Advanced Tech tiers with escalating credit values and capabilities.
body: The source uses the same technological vocabulary across communications, resource items, trade goods, reclaimed synthesis components, weapons, armor, and crafting.
This entry imports the communication and general resource tiers visible immediately before the item-creation chapter.

tables.title: Communications
rows: Short range and prone to interference
Long-range secure communication, GPS and data transfer
Exosuit communicator with AI and holographic interface
High range, translation, secure communication and AI assistance
